wiki.summary: “B’s on the Table” is a high-pressure, flex-heavy track from Drake’s Iceman featuring 21 Savage, centered on money, negotiations, and power dynamics. The song revolves around major financial offers and the idea that every decision has serious stakes, with “B’s” symbolizing billions and high-value deals. Drake uses his verses to express frustration with industry politics, contract negotiations, and loyalty issues, while also flexing wealth, influence, and strategic thinking. Read more on Last.fm.
wiki.content: “B’s on the Table” is a high-pressure, flex-heavy track from Drake’s Iceman featuring 21 Savage, centered on money, negotiations, and power dynamics. The song revolves around major financial offers and the idea that every decision has serious stakes, with “B’s” symbolizing billions and high-value deals. Drake uses his verses to express frustration with industry politics, contract negotiations, and loyalty issues, while also flexing wealth, influence, and strategic thinking. 21 Savage reinforces the cold, calculating tone in the hook, emphasizing that everything is business and nothing is personal. Overall, the track feels tense and transactional, showing Drake fully in control but constantly weighing loyalty against money and power. Read more on Last.fm.
